decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on an established trommel that already has many users, so keeping this option open costs little and it fits the firm's core mobile screening line.
The AK flail shredder series is a core product line that was recently updated to EU Stage V engines, which shows continued commitment and low uncertainty about its value.

The mobile high-speed grinder moved from a mention to a page of its own, and while the parallel green-waste grinder was pruned, this model keeps a still-valuable option in the mobile portfolio at modest cost.

Unlike the dropped stationary fine shredder, the CERON pre-shredder generation shows a concrete plant reference and is positioned as a benchmark, which justifies keeping it despite the higher cost of the stationary segment.
